digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, Python, TypeScript）。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
repos.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matter
repos.summary_zh: 开源自主AI代理框架，让任何人都能构建和运行自动化任务，无需深度编程经验

repos.name: FlowiseAI/Flowise
repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: 拖拽式搭建 AI 智能体的低代码平台，让非开发者也能轻松编排复杂工作流

repos.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
repos.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
repos.summary_zh: 终端常驻的 DeepSeek 原生编码代理，靠前缀缓存稳定省流，跑着就别停

repos.name: jdx/mise
repos.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的开发工具统一管理器，一条命令搞定版本切换、环境变量与任务编排

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: LadybirdBrowser/ladybird
repos.description: Truly independent web browser
repos.summary_zh: 独立打造而非套壳的浏览器引擎，从零构建网页渲染全栈，拒绝商业依赖的纯粹开源选择

repos.name: servo/servo
repos.description: Servo aims to empower developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies in applications.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的浏览器引擎，轻量高性能，专为嵌入式 Web 渲染场景打造

repos.name: quickwit-oss/quickwit
repos.description: Cloud-native OSS search engine for observability
repos.summary_zh: 云原生可观测性搜索引擎，用 Rust 重写成本与性能，替代 Elasticsearch 处理海量日志

repos.name: raphamorim/rio
repos.description: A hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator focusing to run in desktops and browsers.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的 GPU 加速终端模拟器，桌面和浏览器双端运行，性能丝滑如原生应用

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡跑70B大模型，用层卸载突破显存限制，让低配设备也能本地推理

repos.name: ai-dynamo/dynamo
repos.description: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework
repos.summary_zh: 数据中心级分布式推理框架，用 Rust 打造超大规模 LLM 服务弹性调度与吞吐优化

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地运行 Gemma 4 26B 模型，让大模型推理不再吃配置

repos.name: semantica-agi/semantica
repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.summary_zh: 图原生基础设施让 AI 上下文可追溯可审计，专为负责任智能体打造

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: harveyai/harvey-labs
repos.description: A benchmark built to evaluate and improve agent capabilities for supporting legal work.
repos.summary_zh: 专为法律工作打造的 Agent 能力评测基准，用真实任务驱动 AI 在法律场景中更可靠落地

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，精准定位细粒度视觉缺陷

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: 最强模块化扩散模型图形界面与后端，节点式工作流让 AI 绘画和视频生成像搭积木一样灵活

repos.name: ant-design/ant-design
repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
repos.summary_zh: 企业级 React 组件库标杆，开箱即用的中后台设计语言，让开发者专注业务而非样式细节

repos.name: drawdb-io/drawdb
repos.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
repos.summary_zh: 开源在线数据库图表编辑器，拖拽建表自动生成SQL，免安装协作两不误

repos.name: tokio-rs/tokio
repos.description: A runtime for writing reliable asynchronous applications with Rust. Provides I/O, networking, scheduling, timers, ...
repos.summary_zh: Rust 异步编程的事实标准运行时，提供高性能 I/O 与任务调度，让异步代码可靠且易写

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: donnemartin/system-design-primer
repos.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
repos.summary_zh: 系统设计面试百科全书，用图解和案例拆解大型系统架构，附记忆卡助你高效备战

repos.name: practical-tutorials/project-based-learning
repos.description: Curated list of project-based tutorials
repos.summary_zh: 按项目学编程的精选合集，覆盖多语言实战路径，让开发者通过真实项目快速上手

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 和 Tree-sitter 作者打造的高性能多人协作编辑器，用 Rust 实现极速响应与实时共享编码

repos.name: pola-rs/polars
repos.description: Extremely fast Query Engine for DataFrames, written in Rust
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超高速 DataFrame 查询引擎，比 Pandas 快数倍且支持多线程与流式处理
